content:
In addition to releasing the first public beta of iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate, Apple also rolled out revised versions of these developer betas featuring new build numbers. Details are as follows.

Revised versions released alongside the public beta

Alongside the launch of the first public beta, Apple also released revised versions of developer beta 3 for iPadOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate.

The revised iPadOS 27 developer beta 3 carries build number 24A5380l, while the updated macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 3 carries build number 26A5378n.

The reason Apple has released these revised versions remains unclear, as no widespread serious issues had been reported with the previous versions. The changes may have been made to address issues discovered before today's public beta release, but Apple has not provided any details.

We will continue to keep a close eye on these new builds and will report back if there is anything noteworthy.

Have you spotted anything new in the revised versions? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
